overrides.comment: DS 0.1 token architecture (three layers - see src/design-system/tokens/foundation.css's own doc comment): a component must never reference a foundation token or a raw colour literal directly, only the fixed semantic --color-* custom properties in semantic.css. foundation.css itself is exempt below - it's the one file allowed to hold the literal palette. src/app/**/*.css added in Sprint 3 alongside the first real app-shell stylesheets (AppShell/NavRail/TopBar).
